name: Famous Tech International Holdings Limited
summary: Famous Tech International Holdings Limited is an investment holding company, incorporated in 2001 and based in Wan Chai, that develops and distributes PC performance software, anti-virus software, mobile apps and toolbar advertising. Its four segments cover software, securities investment, corporate management solutions with IT contract services, and a B2C online platform with B2B product trading. It was formerly GET Holdings Limited, renamed in July 2024, and operates in Hong Kong and many other countries.
